title: Visit visa vs student visa — what’s the difference? | SK Immigration Services
h1: Visit visa vs student visa — what’s the difference?
description: Visit visa vs student visa from Pakistan: purpose, length, work/study rights, and why mixing routes risks refusal. SK Immigration (SK Consultant) explains both paths honestly.

faqs.question: Visit visa vs student visa — what’s the difference?
faqs.answer: Visit visas are short stays for tourism, family or business and forbid long-term study/work beyond narrow visitor rules. Student visas allow full programs after CAS/admission and living-cost proof. Never enter on a visit visa intending to study long-term — that risks refusal or bans.

faqs.question: Can I switch from visit to student after arrival?
faqs.answer: Usually no — most countries require the correct entry category. Plan the student route from Pakistan. SK Immigration will tell you if a visit file is the wrong tool.

faqs.question: Does SK Immigration guarantee visas?
faqs.answer: No. We prepare complete files; authorities decide.

body:
Answer: A visit visa is for a temporary trip (tourism, family, business) with limited or no study/work rights. A student visa is for an admitted program with living-cost proof and residence rules. From Pakistan, never use a visitor story to hide long-term study plans — embassies treat that as credibility failure.

Side-by-side

Visit visaStudent visa
PurposeTrip, then returnEnrolled study program
Key evidenceTies, funds, itinerary/inviteAdmission/CAS, funds, language
Work rightsUsually none / very limitedOften limited part-time (country rules)
SK starting fee (prep)From PKR 30,000From PKR 50,000

When SK Consultant recommends visit

  • Family wedding / tourism with strong Pakistan return ties
  • Short business meetings with invite and company docs
  • You are not seeking a degree this intake

Start: Visit Visa hub · UK visit · Schengen visit

When SK Consultant recommends student

  • You have (or will get) admission / CAS / blocked-account path
  • Budget covers tuition + living proof
  • Language plan matches the program (IELTS / German / other)

Start: Study Visa hub · eligibility quiz · without IELTS guide

Refusal risks of mixing routes

Visitor applications that look like study intent (university emails, long “holiday” with no return plan) fail often. Student applications with fake visit history or unexplained funds also fail. SK Immigration separates the stories on purpose.

Quick decision rule

If you will sit in a full degree or CAS program, choose student. If you will return after a short trip, choose visit. If you are unsure, take the eligibility quiz or WhatsApp SK before paying any agent deposit.
